title: kith-tui/src/client.rs: JMAP client implementation
description:
What: Implement the async JMAP client module in kith-tui/src/client.rs.

Background:
- kithd TLS cert is raw DER bytes at $KITHD_DATA_DIR/kith.crt (default: ~/.local/share/kithd/kith.crt)
- Session endpoint: GET /.well-known/jmap → JSON (see ClientSession struct below)
- JMAP API endpoint: POST /jmap/api, body=JmapRequest JSON, response=JmapResponse JSON
- SSE endpoint: GET /jmap/events, response text/event-stream
- SSE wire format: event: state\ndata: {"changed":{"a-self":{"Message":"s-42","Chat":"s-3"}}}\n\n
- reqwest 0.12 features needed: json, stream, rustls-tls-manual-roots

Types to define in client.rs:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum ClientError {
    #[error("cert not found: {0}")] CertNotFound(std::path::PathBuf),
    #[error("cert invalid: {0}")] CertInvalid(String),
    #[error("http error: {0}")] Http(#[from] reqwest::Error),
    #[error("response parse error: {0}")] Parse(String),
    #[error("sse error: {0}")] Sse(String),
}

// Minimal deserializable session — only the fields the client needs.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct ClientSession {
    #[serde(rename = "primaryAccounts")]
    pub primary_accounts: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(rename = "apiUrl")]
    pub api_url: String,
    #[serde(rename = "eventSourceUrl")]
    pub event_source_url: String,
    pub state: String,
}

impl ClientSession {
    // Returns the account id for the kith:chat capability.
    // Primary key is "urn:kith:chat:1" → "a-self".
    pub fn account_id(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        self.primary_accounts.get("urn:kith:chat:1").map(String::as_str)
    }
}

// Intermediate type for deserializing SSE data field.
#[derive(Debug, serde::Deserialize)]
struct SseStateChange {
    changed: std::collections::HashMap<String, std::collections::HashMap<String, String>>,
}
```

Functions to implement:

1. pub fn build_client(cert_der: &[u8]) -> Result<reqwest::Client, ClientError>
   - reqwest::Certificate::from_der(cert_der).map_err(|e| ClientError::CertInvalid(e.to_string()))?
   - reqwest::ClientBuilder::new()
       .add_root_certificate(cert)
       .build()
       .map_err(ClientError::Http)
   
   Alternative if rustls-tls-manual-roots doesnt work: use danger_accept_invalid_certs(true).
   Prefer the pinned cert approach; fall back to skip-verify only if rustls-tls-manual-roots fails.

2. pub fn read_cert_der(cert_path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ClientError>
   - std::fs::read(cert_path).map_err(|_| ClientError::CertNotFound(cert_path.to_path_buf()))

3. pub async fn fetch_session(
       client: &reqwest::Client,
       base_url: &str,
   ) -> Result<ClientSession, ClientError>
   - GET {base_url}/.well-known/jmap
   - response.error_for_status()? to surface HTTP errors
   - response.json::<ClientSession>().await.map_err(|e| ClientError::Parse(e.to_string()))

4. pub async fn call_jmap(
       client: &reqwest::Client,
       api_url: &str,
       req: &kith_core::JmapRequest,
   ) -> Result<kith_core::JmapResponse, ClientError>
   - POST api_url, .json(req).send().await?
   - response.error_for_status()?
   - response.json::<kith_core::JmapResponse>().await.map_err(|e| ClientError::Parse(e.to_string()))

5. pub fn spawn_sse(
       client: reqwest::Client,
       event_url: String,
   ) -> (tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<kith_core::StateChange>, tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>)
   - Create mpsc::channel(64)
   - Spawn tokio task:
     a. client.get(&event_url).header("Accept","text/event-stream").send().await
     b. response.bytes_stream() — need: use futures::StreamExt
     c. Accumulate bytes in String buf
     d. On each chunk: append UTF-8 decoded bytes (skip invalid UTF-8 sequences)
     e. Split buf on "\n\n", keep last partial event in buf
     f. For each complete event block:
        - Parse lines: "event: <type>", "data: <json>"
        - If event == "state": deserialize data as SseStateChange
        - For each (account_id, type_states) in changed: for each (type_name, new_state):
          tx.send(StateChange { type_name, new_state }).await (ignore SendError if receiver dropped)
     g. On stream end or error: log warning (eprintln if no tracing), return
   - Return (rx, handle)

6. In kith-tui/src/lib.rs: add "pub mod client;"

Defensive programming rules:
- No unwrap() anywhere in production code paths.
- SSE task: on receiver dropped (tx.send returns Err), break the loop silently.
- SSE task: on chunk error (reqwest Error), eprintln a warning and break loop (do not crash).
- SSE task: on malformed UTF-8, use String::from_utf8_lossy and continue.
- SSE task: on JSON parse failure in data field, skip the event and continue.
- SSE task: ignore "ping" and any unrecognized event types.
- build_client: if rustls-tls-manual-roots feature causes compile error, fall back to danger_accept_invalid_certs(true) (documented in a comment).
- All functions: no key material (cert DER bytes) in any error messages or log lines.

Tests in this bead: none (tests are in the separate W2A bead).
The module must compile and clippy-clean.
